purpose: Orthogonal real project mission: build and independently verify a structural inventory of the live Python runtime source tree without hand-authored parser/tool bindings.
goal: Inspect every Python file under canonical/runtime. Create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/PYTHON_RUNTIME_AUDIT.json containing one record per .py file with its repository-relative path, SHA-256, top-level imported module names, top-level function names, and top-level class names. Include totals for files, functions, classes, and distinct imported modules. Finally independently verify against the raw Python source files that every reported file exists, every reported SHA-256 matches its exact bytes, every reported top-level function and class is actually defined in that file, and fail if any Python file under canonical/runtime is missing from the audit.
